description: Export results you saved as one JSON bundle for a case file or an audit. Each entry has the result's data, its provenance (signature and the sanctions list version, with the list's SHA-256) and a SHA-256 for the entry, and the bundle has a manifest listing them. Filter by case_reference, tool or saved date. Large exports come in pages: pass next_cursor back as cursor. Stored PDF and Word files are left out of the bundle. An account lists its 1,000 most recent saved results, so older ones are not in the export. Check a bundle offline with scripts/verify_result.js. Read-only. Scoped to your account: needs sign-in (/mcp/account) or an API key. Free.

case_reference.description: Only results filed under this case reference.

cursor.description: The next_cursor from the previous page.

max_results.description: Most entries in one page (default 25). A page also stops at a size limit, and then next_cursor is set.

response_detail.description: summary (default) gives a short text and puts the bundle in structuredContent. full also puts the whole bundle in the text.

saved_from.description: Only results saved on or after this date or time (ISO 8601, for example 2026-01-01).

saved_to.description: Only results saved on or before this date or time (ISO 8601). A date alone includes that whole day (UTC).

tool.description: Only results from this tool, for example wallet_screen.

name: saved_results_export

outputSchema.description: Structured response object returned by the tool in structuredContent.

accepts.description: Present when payment is needed: the x402 payment requirements to sign.

artifact.description: Inline generated file artifact. downloadUrl is a private link to the same file that works for 15 minutes; after that only contentBase64 remains.

contentBase64.description: Base64-encoded artifact content to decode and save locally.

downloadExpiresAt.description: When downloadUrl stops working (ISO 8601), 15 minutes after the call.

downloadUrl.description: Private download link for this file, valid until downloadExpiresAt. Give it to the user when they ask for the file.

name.description: Suggested file name for the artifact.

type.description: Artifact document type such as pdf or docx.

artifact_summary.description: Delivery and rendering metadata for an inline generated artifact.

delivery.description: How to retrieve or save the generated artifact.

downloadUrl.description: Hosted download URL when one exists; null when the artifact is inline only.

documentType.description: Rendered artifact type such as pdf or docx.

fileName.description: Suggested file name for the generated artifact.

artifacts.description: Artifact rendering hints keyed by format.

bucket.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: the limit that was reached.

data.description: Primary structured result payload for the tool.

error.description: Machine-readable error code or message when the tool fails.

limit.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: the daily limit.

output.description: Nested renderer output when a workflow bundles an artifact render.

payer.description: Present when a payment was refused: the paying address.

price.description: Present when payment is needed: the price of the call without an account.

remaining.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: how much was left.

anyOf.description: Report-shaped payload with summary, metrics, tables, or evidence.
Null when no saved report is available.

report.description: Report-shaped payload when available; null for status-only retrieval responses.

resetsAt.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: when it resets (ISO 8601).

retryAfterSeconds.description: Present when the account made too many calls: seconds to wait.

anyOf.description: Source route, dataset, or execution metadata for the result.

source.description: Source label, route, dataset, or execution metadata for the result.

support.description: Present on some errors: where to get help.

used.description: Present when a daily limit was reached: how much of it was used today.

x402Version.description: Present when payment is needed: the x402 protocol version.
